tara: Postmortem follow-up: condensed action list for the KV residency leak/oom pattern. Need owners and short ETAs.
lee: I'll own reproducibility on staging and upload traces.
omar: I'll take slab GC experiments and frag threshold tuning on canary.
zhen: ops - I'll add residency-delta alerts and a temporary per-tenant soft-limit guardrail.
ops-bot: runbook: infra/runbooks/kv-residency-guard.md
tara: repro checklist for lee: run 4h peak with alloc-sample=1%, skew=0.85, qps ramp to 18k, collect kv-snap every 30m, upload to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/2418000000/
lee: command:
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kv
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=120 --skew=0.85 --duration=14400 --alloc-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/t.tgz
```
omar: canary plan:
- bump frag_threshold 0.36 -> 0.5 (48h)
- compact aggressive window 60s -> 30s (72h)
- enable eager-evict for segments >96MB (72h)
Rollback on OOM or p99_read_latency > 1.7x.
zhen: ops tasks:
- add alert: residency-delta >18% sustained 10m -> page oncall
- implement tenant soft-multiplier 0.9x for tenants >95th percentile for 48h (opt-out)
- schedule synthetic eviction cron at 02:30 UTC
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: slab-config + guardrail flag -> pool-canary-4 -> ETA 2026-04-12T03:00:00Z
tara: ownership recap (confirm): repro/traces: lee (ETA 24h); canary GC experiments: omar (start 2026-04-12); tenant guardrail + alerts: zhen/ops (ETA 2026-04-12 12:00 UTC); retro writeup: tara (ETA 2026-04-15).
lee: will upload traces and post link when done.
omar: will open PR for canary config and ping for review.
zhen: creating alert ticket and RFC for guardrail; will link here.
tara: thanks, reconvene in 48h with metrics. If any canary OOM, page #eng-oncall immediately.
